lines.en: I stride along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 我背上的帆在阳光下很宽。
lines.en: My sail is broad in the sun.

lines.zh: 每一步都压得泥陷下去。
lines.en: Each step presses the mud down.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在水边留下深坑。
lines.en: My claws leave deep pits at the water's edge.
I lower my long snout across the water.
I come out of the reeds.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像踩着自家的院。
lines.en: I walk surely, as if in my own yard.
The smell of the river slows me.
I take a few steps and look back.
I cave in the muddy bank.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转身，水花溅起。
lines.en: I turn slowly and water sprays.
I dip my snout into the shallows.
I smell fish darting past my feet.

lines.zh: 我的帆上停着几只小虫。
lines.en: A few insects rest on my sail.
I look down at my reflection.
This river is mine.
My breath moves the reeds.
I hold still like a bank stone.

lines.zh: 我在听水下游动的声音。
lines.en: I listen to movement under the water.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的帆照得发亮。
lines.en: The sun lights my sail.
I raise my long snout slowly.
I swing my tail once, slowly.
Water runs down my legs.
The wind snaps at my sail.
You are standing on my bank.
I have looked at you longer than at fish.
You smell of cooked fish.
Your shadow is on the water.
I lower my head to your eye level.

lines.zh: 这一带的水深不过我的膝。
lines.en: The water here is not past my knee.
If you run, you must cross the river first.
My teeth are long as nails.
That stick in your hand is too thin.
I smell fish on your hands.
You stand there without retreating.

lines.zh: 我看你比看这块地更久。
lines.en: I look at you longer than at this land.
You cut my hide; the wound is shallow.
It hurts, but this hide is thick.
I growl and the reeds shake.
That turned my head aside.
There is a tear in my sail.
You cut well, truly.
I will come again from the water.
That one. I can still stand.
Fish; I want fish.
That fishy smell comes down the current.
I turn my head that way.
What you hold up is not enough either.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，能吞下你整条手臂。
lines.en: I could swallow your whole arm.
Put it down; don't shake.
Let me take a mouthful of water first.
The fish in this river hide from me.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼的味道，让我长吻发颤。
lines.en: That big fish's scent makes my long snout quiver.
Not enough; have you more?

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，像撞船。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a hull.
I do not shift; water sprays up.
That knock sent you back four steps.
My hide is thicker than you think.
I shoulder you aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，泥都翻起来。
lines.en: Mud churns where we meet.
My sail shudders.
Don't stand by my tail.
You fall into the shallows.
Good; get up.
This river has room for only me.

lines.zh: 我是从化石里被复活的。
lines.en: I was revived from fossil stone.

lines.zh: 这种问题在泥里问不合适。
lines.en: This is no question for the mud.

lines.zh: 我低头，长吻几乎碰到你。
lines.en: I lower my snout almost to you.
What I want is water, not comfort.

lines.zh: 这条河养不下第二条我这样的。
lines.en: This river will not feed a second like me.

lines.zh: 我这具身体不属于这个时代。
lines.en: This body does not belong to this age.
I snort out a breath and walk off.
That sentence ends here.
I lower my head and take it up.
It is like a splinter between my teeth.
I step on it and press it into the mud.
This is too light — gone in one bite.
I try a bite; it crushes.
I push it into the shallows.
I sniff; it is not to my taste.
Leave it; the fish will come.
You have stepped into my river.
You are the only one on this bank.
I have squared myself up.

lines.zh: 水位只到你的腰，你跑不快。
lines.en: The water is at your waist; you cannot run fast.
My snout arrives first.

lines.zh: 这一段河岸没有别的路。
lines.en: This bank offers no other way.
I step into the shallows and come.
I can smell the blood on you.
My sail rises in the wind.
You look back too often.
My stride is quicker than it looks.
I open my jaws first.
Good; then come on.
I follow along the bank.

lines.zh: 你跑到芦苇里，我踩平它。
lines.en: You hide in the reeds; I flatten them.

lines.zh: 水声把我的脚步掩住了。
lines.en: The water muffles my steps.
I am upstream of you.

lines.zh: 我低下头，嗅你经过的地方。
lines.en: I lower my head to sniff your trail.
The path you chose is shallow.
My tail drags behind me.
You have stopped; perfect.
I work around ahead of you.
Nothing hides on a sandbar.
I quicken half a step.
A few steps more.
My snout sweeps across.
My jaws close on your shoulder.
I raise a foreleg and press down.
You are knocked into the water.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的皮上，滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my hide.
I drag you toward deeper water.
I pin you with one leg.
The river is churned to mud.
You break free and swim for the bank.
I do not chase; I am faster in water.

lines.zh: 我的背帆，比你的屋顶高。
lines.en: My sail is taller than your roof.
That will last you a lifetime.
You cough water and cannot rise.
I rise from the riverbank mud.
My sail opens in the air.
The water is shallow, but enough.

lines.zh: 我闻到的全是陌生的味道。
lines.en: All the smells are strange.
I step slowly, slowly.
Small things run along the bank.
I am a creature that was made.

lines.zh: 我的影子遮住了半条河。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the river.

lines.zh: 我知道我在哪一类地方。
lines.en: I know what kind of place this is.
I lower my head and drink once.
Good; first, claim this bank.
I dig my claws into the river mud.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过一片浅滩。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a stretch of shallows.
The current here is slack.

lines.zh: 我抬头，嗅到了新的气味。
lines.en: I raise my head and catch a new scent.

lines.zh: 天光落在水面上，很刺眼。
lines.en: The sky glare on the water is harsh.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往岸上走了半步。
lines.en: I take a half step up the bank.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的帆，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire catches my sail and chars it.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下去，砸进河里。
lines.en: I fall from the bank into the river.

lines.zh: 河水灌进长吻，我的帆背也沉了。
lines.en: Water floods my snout; even my sail back sinks.
The blast rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着水缠上我的腿。
lines.en: That force coils up my legs through the water.

lines.zh: 河里没有鱼，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: No fish in the river; hunger blurs my sight.

lines.zh: 雷劈在河面上，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I go numb.
The river is gone; my legs thrash.
